notes:
Dev build of Tally for Windows, with the 14-day trial.

After 14 days without a license your books open read-only: you can still view them, run reports and export. Buy a license from About (or the banner) and enter the key there to keep editing. Licenses come from the staging license server (staging-pay.g3tech.net, Stripe test mode).

Changes since 0.1.1:

- chore(release): tally 0.1.2 (5220e99)
- feat(app): a 14-day trial, then a license key or read-only books (638a8d7)
- feat(store): a read-only switch that refuses saves but keeps every read (f97e912)
- feat(app): show what is owed on cards and loans in red (0d1730a)
- build: patch the Dioxus fork and g3 crates from git (dd1eaad)
